verdict.rationale: LangGraph is pip-installable open-source and supports self-hosted persistence via database-backed checkpointers (e.g., Postgres) and a local dev server, so the core graph-execution engine can run entirely on your own infra. However, the documented production deployment path (`langgraph deploy`) pushes directly to LangSmith Deployments, a vendor-hosted platform, and a community question explicitly asks how to deploy LangGraph in production outside of vendor tooling — indicating self-hosted production deployment is not clearly first-class. Missing for 10: first-party documented self-hosted Agent Server production deployment guide, and independent confirmation that a fully vendor-free production deployment (scaling, ops) works well.
